questions.question: When parking uphill next to a curb, set the parking brake and:

options.text: Keep the rear tires against the curb.
Keep the front tires straight ahead.
Turn your steering wheel away from the curb.
Turn your steering wheel toward the curb.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your steering wheel away from the curb.
questions.explanation: When parking uphill on a street with a curb, set your parking brake and turn the steering wheel away from the curb. If your car rolls, it will roll into the curb.

questions.question: When driving to an unfamiliar area, you should:

options.text: Depend on road signs to find your way.
Plan your trip in advance.
Only know generally where your destination is.
Always choose the most direct route.

questions.correctAnswerText: Plan your trip in advance.
questions.explanation: Plan your trip in advance before driving to an unfamiliar area. Don't start with only a general idea of where you're going. Check the location on a map before you start driving.

questions.question: If an oncoming driver is heading toward you in your lane, you should:

options.text: Blow your horn, steer right, and accelerate.
Blow your horn, steer left, and brake.
Blow your horn, steer right, and brake.
Stay in the center of your lane, blow your horn, and brake.

questions.correctAnswerText: Blow your horn, steer right, and brake.
questions.explanation: If another car is coming at you head-on, honk your horn first to get attention. If they don't move, try to escape to the right. Steering left is risky because if they correct at the last moment, you'll still crash. If a crash is unavoidable, brake firmly and steadily. Every mile per hour you slow down reduces the impact.

questions.question: A single broken white line down the center of a two-lane road means:

options.text: Traffic moves in opposite directions and drivers cannot pass.
Traffic moves in opposite directions and drivers can pass when safe.
Traffic moves in the same direction and drivers cannot pass.
Traffic moves in the same direction and drivers can pass when safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic moves in the same direction and drivers can pass when safe.
questions.explanation: White lines separate traffic moving in the same direction. Dashed white lines mean drivers can pass when it is safe to do so.

questions.question: A red flashing traffic light means the same thing as a:

options.text: Solid red light.
Stop sign.
Yield sign.
Caution sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop sign.
questions.explanation: A red flashing signal means the same as a stop sign. Come to a complete stop and proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: When changing lanes, you should:

options.text: Rely only on your mirrors.
Begin signaling as you move into the next lane.
Signal 500 feet before changing lanes on residential streets.
Always check your blind spot.

questions.correctAnswerText: Always check your blind spot.
questions.explanation: Cars and motorcycles can hide in your blind spot, so look over your shoulder before changing lanes. Signal 100 feet before changing lanes on residential streets. Signal five seconds before changing lanes on a freeway.

questions.question: When driving on slippery roads, you should:

options.text: Always drive at the maximum speed limit.
Use cruise control to maintain steady speed.
Reduce your following distance.
Not make any sudden changes in speed or direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Not make any sudden changes in speed or direction.
questions.explanation: Avoid sudden changes in speed or direction on slippery surfaces. Reduce your speed and do not use cruise control.

questions.question: You want to turn left at an intersection with a green light, but oncoming traffic is heavy. You should:

options.text: Use the next intersection.
Wait at the crosswalk for traffic to clear.
Wait in the center of the intersection for traffic to clear.
Go because you have the green light.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait in the center of the intersection for traffic to clear.
questions.explanation: When turning left with approaching traffic, wait for them to pass before you turn. You can enter the intersection to prepare for your left turn if the light is green and no other car ahead is turning left.

questions.question: Drivers should be extra alert to motorcyclists, bicyclists, and pedestrians because:

options.text: They're hard to see in traffic.
They follow different traffic laws than cars.
They always have the right-of-way.
They don't have rearview mirrors.

questions.correctAnswerText: They're hard to see in traffic.
questions.explanation: In many crashes with motorcycles, bicycles, and pedestrians, drivers said they were looking but didn't see them. These are harder to spot because they're smaller, move faster, and have less visible lighting. Always watch for motorcycles, bikes, and pedestrians to prevent crashes.

questions.question: Regulatory signs:

options.text: Are placed in every location where there is danger.
Tell drivers what they must or must not do.
Are diamond-shaped and yellow or green.
May warn drivers about school zones.

questions.correctAnswerText: Tell drivers what they must or must not do.
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are usually rectangular with white backgrounds and black markings. They tell drivers what they must or must not do. They show speed limits, prohibit passing or turning, or explain other driving rules.

questions.question: When a vehicle ahead has its high beams on, where should you look?

options.text: Either side
The center
The right side
The left side

questions.correctAnswerText: The right side
questions.explanation: Look toward the right side of the road. This keeps you from being blinded by the bright headlights and helps you stay on your path until the other vehicle passes.

questions.question: If your vehicle skids, what should you do?

options.text: Overcorrect.
Turn your steering wheel into traffic.
Turn your steering wheel in the direction of the skid.
Release the steering wheel.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your steering wheel in the direction of the skid.
questions.explanation: Stay calm and steer in the direction the vehicle is skidding.

questions.question: What color are most warning signs?

options.text: Red.
Yellow.
Green.
Blue.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yellow.
questions.explanation: Most warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black markings. They warn drivers about unexpected hazards ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians only.
Intersection ahead.
Hiking trails ahead.
School crossing ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: School crossing ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a school crossing is ahead.

questions.question: Which statement is true?

options.text: It is okay for drivers of other vehicles to follow motorcycles closely.
A motorcycle with two people on it is more balanced than a motorcycle with just one rider.
When passing a motorcycle, you must move completely into the left lane.
Drivers can expect a motorcycle's brake lights to turn on when the rider slows down.

questions.correctAnswerText: When passing a motorcycle, you must move completely into the left lane.
questions.explanation: Motorcycles need the full width of a lane. Make sure your vehicle is completely in the left lane before passing a motorcycle.

questions.question: What should you do when you see a steady yellow arrow traffic signal?

options.text: Merge into a lane in the direction of the arrow.
Slow down and stop, if safe.
Turn left after yielding to oncoming traffic and pedestrians.
Go—you have the right of way and oncoming traffic will stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and stop, if safe.
questions.explanation: A steady yellow arrow means a red arrow is coming next. Stop unless you are already in the intersection.

questions.question: What is a speed limit?

options.text: The maximum or minimum legal speed under dangerous conditions.
The maximum or minimum legal speed under ideal conditions.
The suggested speed under ideal conditions.
None of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum or minimum legal speed under ideal conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit is the maximum or minimum legal speed under ideal conditions. You can drive slower, but driving faster is illegal. Drive slower in school or work zones. If weather or road conditions make the speed unsafe, drive below the limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No passing zone.
Winding road.
Pedestrian crossing.
Low ground railroad crossing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Low ground railroad crossing.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a low ground railroad crossing. Railroad tracks cross the road at a steep angle, and the bottom of low vehicles may drag or get stuck on the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: One-way traffic.
Divided highway ends.
Two-way traffic.
Keep left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Divided highway ends.
questions.explanation: This diamond-shaped yellow sign with black markings warns drivers of hazards. This sign means the divided highway is ending.

questions.question: What causes most fatal crashes between large trucks and passenger vehicles?

options.text: The driver of the passenger vehicle.
Bad weather.
Nighttime driving.
Animals on the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: The driver of the passenger vehicle.
questions.explanation: In more than 70 percent of fatal crashes between a passenger vehicle and a truck, the passenger vehicle driver caused the crash. Give large trucks plenty of space.
